policy.worker_protocol: Exact match is required. A mismatch returns PROTOCOL_ERROR before operation execution.
policy.worker_api: Optional request field; absent means v1. Unsupported versions return WORKER_API_UNSUPPORTED.
policy.required_features: Every required feature must be registered for the requested operation. Unknown or mismatched requirements return FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE before runtime imports.
policy.operation_registry: protocol.py owns the operation-to-feature registry. Dispatcher routes are checked against it, and doctor capability IDs are derived from its feature union plus explicitly registered host features.
policy.state_formats: State format versions are independent of the worker protocol. Unsupported versions are rejected; fields are never guessed or silently migrated.
policy.support_claim: Only operations exercised by the current runtime and platform may be reported supported. Conditional and unknown capabilities include a reason.

interfaces.compatibility: request API version is explicit; omitted v1 remains accepted
unsupported contract versions are rejected by OperationPlan::validate
schema_version=1 and extension_api_version=1; static validation does not import component code
API v1 callable remains accepted; API v2 adds a replayable describe/can_edit/plan/candidate/persist/rollback lifecycle. Provider conformance-suite version is independently pinned and must match.

state_formats.legacy_policy: schema_version=1 is read without requiring new revision fields
unknown lock versions are rejected with an actionable diagnostic
unknown payload versions are rejected; optimizer/RNG/data state restore is explicit

state_formats.owner: Rust variant repository and Python edit replay
state_formats.legacy_policy: unknown variant versions are rejected before edits are applied

state_formats.owner: Rust application and Python edit domain
state_formats.legacy_policy: unsupported plan versions are rejected before mutation
unknown schema/API versions are rejected before component import or execution

state_formats.owner: Rust project-level artifact resolver and typed run-scoped producer/consumer declarations
state_formats.legacy_policy: v1 remains readable but cannot authorize project cleanup; active/unknown, incomplete, malformed, or dangling identities fail closed; release retains the catalog and marks removed members unavailable

host_state_formats.legacy_policy: run.json must declare schema_version=1; unknown versions are refused for read, mutation, checkpoint access, and cleanup without rewriting the record.
